faces.name: You're Ambushed on the Road
faces.oracleText:
Choose one —
• Make a Retreat — Return target creature you control to its owner's hand.
• Stand and Fight — Target creature gets +1/+3 until end of turn.

faces.name: You're Confronted by Robbers
faces.oracleText:
Choose one —
• Stall for Time — Tap up to three target creatures.
• Call for Aid — Create three 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens.

faces.name: You're in Command
faces.oracleText: Choose target creature you own and control. That creature becomes your commander. Any other commanders you have are no longer your commander. (That creature starts with a commander tax of {0}.)

faces.name: You're Not Alone
faces.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. If you control three or more creatures, it gets +4/+4 until end of turn instead.

faces.name: You're Toast!
faces.oracleText: Exile target nonland permanent. Its controller manifests bread. (They look at the top two cards of their library and put one into their graveyard and the other onto the battlefield face down as a Food artifact with "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: You gain 3 life." It can't be turned face up. It's bread.)

faces.name: Your Fate Ends Here
faces.oracleText: Destroy target creature or planeswalker with mana value 3 or greater. Surveil 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put it into your graveyard.)

faces.name: Your Fate Is Thrice Sealed
faces.oracleText: When you set this scheme in motion, reveal the top three cards of your library. Put all land cards revealed this way onto the battlefield and the rest into your hand.

faces.name: Your Favorite Character
faces.oracleText: As the game begins, if Your Favorite Character is your commander, or as Your Favorite Character enters the battlefield if it's not your commander, name a character from the Magic storyline. Choose up to three colors, two creature types, and then two keywords from among vigilance, flying, haste, trample, and menace. Your Favorite Character has the chosen name, types, colors, and keywords.
